p.title: The assertion-trace gate checked the format of a ledger id, not that the id exists
p.symptom: A label citing P9999 passed as traced.
p.root_cause: The gate only matched a pattern.
p.fix: A label whose only evidence is a P/R id must resolve to an entry in the _context ledgers or CHANGELOG; labels that also cite a T/QA/workstream id keep that evidence.
p.prevention: ci-assertion-trace-check lists dangling ids; it also failed on this change's own unrecorded ids until they were recorded, which is the intended behaviour.

r.title: A cited ledger id must exist
r.rule: A test label that cites only P/R ids passes the trace gate only if each id resolves to a ledger entry; other evidence kinds (T, QA, workstream ids) are unchanged.
